name: PT Urban Jakarta Propertindo Tbk.
summary: PT Urban Jakarta Propertindo Tbk. develops and sells real estate properties in Indonesia. It develops, leases, and manages office areas, shopping centers, and apartments, as well as residential and commercial development. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Urban Jakarta Propertindo Tbk. operates as a subsidiary of PT Nusa Wijaya Propertindo.
